title: Quality Control Assessment for Microbial Genomes Using GalaxyTrakr MicroRunQC Workflow
author: Candace Hope Bias
materials: Log into your GalaxyTrakr account: https://galaxytrakr.org

steps.title: Create GalaxyTrakr Account
steps.instruction: Register for a GalaxyTrakr account using the detailed registration form.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to https://account.galaxytrakr.org/Account/Register to create the account.

steps.title: Initialize Analysis History
steps.instruction: Create and name a new history to organize the MiSeq Run data.

substeps.instruction: Click the + icon in the upper right History panel.
Click on 'Unnamed history', enter a name including the flow-cell ID and date, and hit Enter.

steps.title: Upload Fastq Files
steps.instruction: Upload the paired raw fastq files into the active History panel.

substeps.instruction: Click the Upload icon in the GalaxyTrakr menu.
Set 'Type (set all)' to 'auto-detect'.
Click 'Choose local files', navigate to the desired paired fastq files (two per sample/isolate), and click 'Start'.

steps.title: Create List of Dataset Pairs
steps.instruction: Pair the uploaded forward (R1) and reverse (R2) reads.

substeps.instruction: In the History panel, select the uploaded files by clicking 'All' or selecting them individually.
Click 'Select All' and choose 'Advance Build List', then select 'List of Paired Datasets'.
In the new window, verify that _R1 and _R2 are the selected pairing options (use the filter icon if a different suffix is needed).
Click 'Next', verify the dataset names, name the list, and click 'Build'.

steps.title: Import MicroRunQC Workflow
steps.instruction: Add the MicroRunQC workflow to your personal Workflows panel.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to the 'Workflow' menu and click 'Public workflows'.
Search for 'MicroRunQC_v1.2' and click 'Import'.

steps.title: Run MicroRunQC Workflow
steps.instruction: Execute the MicroRunQC_v1.2 workflow using the previously created dataset collection.

substeps.instruction: Click the 'Workflow' tab on the main menu and select 'My Workflows'.
Click the star to bookmark 'MicrorunQC_v1.2'.
Click the play icon to run 'MicroRunQC_v1.2' and select the paired dataset collection.
Click 'Run Workflow' and wait for the History pane tiles to turn green.

steps.title: Export and Save QC Report
steps.instruction: View and download the final quality control report.

substeps.instruction: In the 'MicroRunQC_v1_2_Report' tile, click the 'Eye' icon to view the output table.
Click the floppy disc icon to download the tabular file.
Open the file in a text reader or convert it to .txt for use in Excel.
Save the output to a LIMS or a spreadsheet linked to the sequencing run.
